# 1 Enoch Chapter 16 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from whose souls the spirits have gone forth and shall continue to destroy — without incurring judgment — until the day of the consummation, the great day of judgment, in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated.

**2** And now, as for the Watchers who sent you to intercede for them, who were formerly in heaven, say to them:

**3** 'You were in heaven, but not all the mysteries had been revealed to you; you knew only the worthless ones, and these, in the hardness of your hearts, you made known to women; and through these mysteries women and men work much evil upon the earth.'

**4** Say to them therefore: 'You shall have no peace.'

---

*LOGOS notes: Chapter 16 concludes the divine speech begun in ch. 15 with two final pronouncements: (1) the temporal scope of the evil spirits' activity (v. 1 — from the slaughter of the giants until the final judgment); (2) the additional accusation that the Watchers revealed mysteries they had not themselves fully received (v. 3). The final four-word verdict 'You shall have no peace' (v. 4) echoes the verdicts of chs. 5 and 12.*
